s0501.literal: Sichuan branch secretariat officials said: "At courier stations everywhere, under the old system route darughachis jointly supervised them; now riverside water courier stations on distant stretches are circuitous — officials of the subordinate prefectures and counties should be ordered to govern them uniformly.
s0501.idiomatic: Sichuan branch secretariat officials said, "At courier stations everywhere, under the old system route darughachis jointly supervised them; now riverside water courier stations on distant stretches are circuitous — officials of the subordinate prefectures and counties should be ordered to govern them uniformly.

s0503.literal: Courier stations at Wang Hunmudun and elsewhere in the Gansu branch secretariat were added; the Fujian Salt Levy Intendant Office was established, subordinate to the pacification commission.
s0503.idiomatic: Courier stations at Wang Hunmudun and elsewhere in the Gansu branch secretariat were added; the Fujian Salt Levy Intendant Office was established, subordinate to the pacification commission.

s0504.literal: On gengxu day the canal at Zhen and Yang and other prefectures was dredged; salt merchants were required to pay two ingots of notes per salt certificate as labor costs.
s0504.idiomatic: On gengxu day the canal at Zhen and Yang and other prefectures was dredged; salt merchants were required to pay two ingots of notes per salt certificate as labor costs.

s0505.literal: On dingsi day Venus transgressed Establishment.
s0505.idiomatic: On dingsi day Venus transgressed Establishment.

s0506.literal: On wuwu day the Jiangnan White Cloud Sect metropolitan chief monks registry was abolished; its lay followers were returned to prefectures and counties, monks to their respective temples, and all fields made to pay rent.
s0506.idiomatic: On wuwu day the Jiangnan White Cloud Sect metropolitan chief monks registry was abolished; its lay followers were returned to prefectures and counties, monks to their respective temples, and all fields made to pay rent.

s0507.literal: On renxu day one hundred thousand Henan commoners were mobilized to build river defenses.
s0507.idiomatic: On renxu day 100,000 Henan commoners were mobilized to build river defenses.

s0508.literal: On bingyin day, because Shadur's following was impoverished, grain was granted for two months.
s0508.idiomatic: On bingyin day, because Shadur's following was impoverished, grain was granted for two months.

s0509.literal: On dingmao day princes, imperial sons-in-law, and princess consorts who memorialized requesting money and grain were ordered to discuss with the central secretariat before acting.
s0509.idiomatic: On dingmao day princes, imperial sons-in-law, and princess consorts who memorialized requesting money and grain were ordered to discuss with the central secretariat before acting.

s0510.literal: Patrol inspectors were promoted to ninth rank; close attendants were forbidden to summon outer-prefecture officials by courier post without authorization; the liquor ban in Datong Route was relaxed; imperial son-in-law Hebo was enfeoffed as Prince of Zhaowu; the National University was built on the west side of the Temple of the Duke of Culture and Propagation.
s0510.idiomatic: Patrol inspectors were promoted to ninth rank; close attendants were forbidden to summon outer-prefecture officials by courier post without authorization; the liquor ban in Datong Route was relaxed; imperial son-in-law Hebo was enfeoffed as Prince of Zhaowu; the National University was built on the west side of the Temple of the Duke of Culture and Propagation.

s0511.literal: An edict forbade interference with the salt laws in each circuit; because Leijia station households in the capital region were impoverished, five hundred ingots of notes were granted.
s0511.idiomatic: An edict forbade interference with the salt laws in each circuit; because Leijia station households in the capital region were impoverished, 500 ingots of notes were granted.

s0512.literal: People in Huailai County, Fengsheng Prefecture were starving; nine hundred ingots of notes were granted.
s0512.idiomatic: People in Huailai County, Fengsheng Prefecture were starving; 900 ingots of notes were granted.

s0513.literal: Intercalary first month, on guiyou day Venus transgressed Ox.
s0513.idiomatic: In the intercalary first month, on guiyou day, Venus transgressed Ox.

s0514.literal: On jiaxu day grain for three months was granted to the people under Prince Hemin who remained at Fengxiang.
s0514.idiomatic: On jiaxu day grain for three months was granted to the people under Prince Hemin who remained at Fengxiang.

s0515.literal: On renwu day two thousand shi of rice were granted to Prince Yesian Temur's following; two months' grain was granted to soldiers of Anbo Batu garrisoned in the eastern territories.
s0515.idiomatic: On renwu day 2,000 shi of rice were granted to Prince Yesian Temur's following; two months' grain was granted to soldiers of Anbo Batu garrisoned in the eastern territories.

s0516.literal: On dinghai day this year's rent and levies in Dadu were remitted.
s0516.idiomatic: On dinghai day this year's rent and levies in Dadu were remitted.

s0517.literal: On jichou day Venus transgressed Encampment.
s0517.idiomatic: On jichou day Venus transgressed Encampment.

s0518.literal: On jiawu day former central secretariat pingzhang Tiege, Jiangsu-Zhejiang branch secretariat pingzhang Chieli, and Henan branch secretariat pingzhang Asan were all made central secretariat pingzhang;
s0518.idiomatic: On jiawu day former central secretariat pingzhang Tiege, Jiangsu-Zhejiang branch secretariat pingzhang Chieli, and Henan branch secretariat pingzhang Asan were all made central secretariat pingzhang;

s0519.literal: pacification commissioner of the Bureau of Buddhist Affairs Zhang Lu and Sichuan branch secretariat left vice director Du Sijing were both made central secretariat left vice directors;
s0519.idiomatic: pacification commissioner of the Bureau of Buddhist Affairs Zhang Lu and Sichuan branch secretariat left vice director Du Sijing were both made central secretariat left vice directors;

s0520.literal: central secretariat deliberator Liu Yuan was made associate administrator.
s0520.idiomatic: central secretariat deliberator Liu Yuan was made associate administrator.

s0521.literal: That month, because Yucheng County in Cao Prefecture last year suffered rain damage to crops and the people were starving, more than two thousand shi of grain from Ling Prefecture was issued for relief.
s0521.idiomatic: That month, because Yucheng County in Cao Prefecture last year suffered rain damage to crops and the people were starving, more than 2,000 shi of grain from Ling Prefecture was issued for relief.

s0522.literal: Jinning and Jining suffered continuous earthquakes.
s0522.idiomatic: Jinning and Jining suffered continuous earthquakes.

s0523.literal: Second month, on renyin day two months' grain was granted to Jinlan station households unable to support themselves; three months' grain was granted to the impoverished under the thousand-household Xiao Xiegan.
s0523.idiomatic: In the second month, on renyin day, two months' grain was granted to Jinlan station households unable to support themselves; three months' grain was granted to the impoverished under the thousand-household Xiao Xiegan.

s0524.literal: On xinhai day central secretariat officials said: "Close attendants have transmitted over one hundred fifty persons with written recommendations to the secretariat, ordering us to select and appoint them.
s0524.idiomatic: On xinhai day central secretariat officials said, "Close attendants have transmitted over 150 persons with written recommendations to the secretariat, ordering us to select and appoint them.

s0525.literal: Among them many have advanced through lawless means; selection should be strengthened.
s0525.idiomatic: Among them many have advanced through lawless means; selection should be strengthened.

s0527.literal: " The Acting Directorate of Waterways was promoted to regular third rank; route document controllers were set at ninth rank.
s0527.idiomatic: The Acting Directorate of Waterways was promoted to regular third rank; route document controllers were set at ninth rank.

s0528.literal: Imperial son-in-law Prince of Jining Manzidai, because his following's expenses were insufficient, requested advance payment of the year's five-household silk allotment; this was approved.
s0528.idiomatic: Imperial son-in-law Prince of Jining Manzidai, because his following's expenses were insufficient, requested advance payment of the year's five-household silk allotment; this was approved.

s0529.literal: Impoverished Han soldiers of the Six Guards were sent home to rest for one year.
s0529.idiomatic: Impoverished Han soldiers of the Six Guards were sent home to rest for one year.

s0530.literal: On bingchen day Boluo was enfeoffed as Prince of Zhenning and granted a gold seal.
s0530.idiomatic: On bingchen day Boluo was enfeoffed as Prince of Zhenning and granted a gold seal.

s0531.literal: Duowa sent envoys to court; robes and silks were granted and they were dismissed.
s0531.idiomatic: Duowa sent envoys to court; robes and silks were granted and they were dismissed.

s0532.literal: On wuwu day the moon transgressed Root.
s0532.idiomatic: On wuwu day the moon transgressed Root.

s0533.literal: On jiwei day Tabudai, pacification commissioner of the Jiangxi-Fujian Circuit, was guilty of corruption but met amnesty; his crime was pardoned and he was never to be reappointed.
s0533.idiomatic: On jiwei day Tabudai, pacification commissioner of the Jiangxi-Fujian Circuit, was guilty of corruption but met amnesty; his crime was pardoned and he was never to be reappointed.

s0534.literal: On dingmao day Yuegu Buhua was made central secretariat left vice director.
s0534.idiomatic: On dingmao day Yuegu Buhua was made central secretariat left vice director.

s0535.literal: On wuchen day the imperial carriage proceeded to the Upper Capital.
s0535.idiomatic: On wuchen day the imperial carriage proceeded to the Upper Capital.

s0536.literal: Prince of Anxi Ananda, Prince of Xiping Oljei, and Buliyi were granted thirty thousand ingots of notes; Nageban ten thousand ingots; followers thirty-two thousand ingots.
s0536.idiomatic: Prince of Anxi Ananda, Prince of Xiping Oljei, and Buliyi were granted 30,000 ingots of notes; Nageban 10,000 ingots; followers 32,000 ingots.

s0537.literal: People under Prince Shuosiban, Martial and Tranquil Prince Pacifier of the West, were starving; Gansu grain was issued for relief.
s0537.idiomatic: People under Prince Shuosiban, Martial and Tranquil Prince Pacifier of the West, were starving; Gansu grain was issued for relief.

s0538.literal: That month Datong Route suffered violent wind and heavy snow, destroying commoners' houses; the next day rain and sand darkened the sky; many horses and cattle died, and some people also died.
s0538.idiomatic: That month Datong Route suffered violent wind and heavy snow, destroying commoners' houses; the next day rain and sand darkened the sky; many horses and cattle died, and some people also died.

s0539.literal: Third month, on wuyin day Jupiter transgressed Kang.
s0539.idiomatic: In the third month, on wuyin day, Jupiter transgressed Kang.

s0540.literal: On jimao day the King of Konggu sent envoys to present local products as tribute.
s0540.idiomatic: On jimao day the King of Konggu sent envoys to present local products as tribute.

s0541.literal: On yiwei day prisoners in Dadu were reviewed; three death-row prisoners at Shangdu were released.
s0541.idiomatic: On yiwei day prisoners in Dadu were reviewed; three death-row prisoners at Shangdu were released.

s0542.literal: Imperial son-in-law Manzidai was granted ten thousand ingots of notes.
s0542.idiomatic: Imperial son-in-law Manzidai was granted 10,000 ingots of notes.

s0543.literal: Heavy rain in Yingdao and elsewhere in Daozhou Prefecture; the river overflowed and mountains split, washing away commoners' houses; many drowned; their field rent was remitted.
s0543.idiomatic: Heavy rain in Yingdao and elsewhere in Daozhou Prefecture; the river overflowed and mountains split, washing away commoners' houses; many drowned; their field rent was remitted.

s0544.literal: Because people in Rencheng County, Jizhou Prefecture were starving, ten thousand shi of grain were granted for relief.
s0544.idiomatic: Because people in Rencheng County, Jizhou Prefecture were starving, 10,000 shi of grain were granted for relief.

s0545.literal: Three months' grain was granted to the division of Qianjia Musidaibo.
s0545.idiomatic: Three months' grain was granted to the division of Qianjia Musidaibo.

s0546.literal: People in Liuzhou were starving; one month's grain was granted.
s0546.idiomatic: People in Liuzhou were starving; one month's grain was granted.

s0547.literal: Wang Tianxianu of Hejian murdered his father and was quartered in the marketplace.
s0547.idiomatic: Wang Tianxianu of Hejian murdered his father and was quartered in the marketplace.

s0548.literal: Summer, fourth month, on gengzi new moon: an edict proclaimed that all who concealed hawks or dogs forfeited half their household property and received thirty blows; those who came forward to surrender them received rewards.
s0548.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the gengzi new moon, an edict proclaimed that all who concealed hawks or dogs forfeited half their household property and received 30 blows; those who came forward to surrender them received rewards.

s0549.literal: On jiachen day privy council officials said: "At Taihe Ridge garrison-farm fields, a garrison-grain storage commission was formerly established solely to oversee their schedule.
s0549.idiomatic: On jiachen day privy council officials said, "At Taihe Ridge garrison-farm fields, a garrison-grain storage commission was formerly established solely to oversee their schedule.

s0550.literal: Each person was given fifty mu of land and required to deliver thirty shi of grain annually; if other corvée kept them from farming, the full levy was still exacted — people were severely distressed.
s0550.idiomatic: Each person was given 50 mu of land and required to deliver 30 shi of grain annually; if other corvée kept them from farming, the full levy was still exacted — people were severely distressed.

s0551.literal: We request that military officers govern them, with pacification commissioner Yulongshibuhua supervising the whole, rewarding or punishing according to how much civilians and soldiers harvest.
s0551.idiomatic: We request that military officers govern them, with pacification commissioner Yulongshibuhua supervising the whole, rewarding or punishing according to how much civilians and soldiers harvest.

s0553.literal: On dingwei day Prince Chubo, Martial and Majestic Prince of Xining, was ordered to take charge of military and courier affairs in Gansu and other areas.
s0553.idiomatic: On dingwei day Prince Chubo, Martial and Majestic Prince of Xining, was ordered to take charge of military and courier affairs in Gansu and other areas.

s0554.literal: On xinyou day Saturn transgressed Kang.
s0554.idiomatic: On xinyou day Saturn transgressed Kang.

s0555.literal: On renxu day Abang Longshao, garrison commander of Luoxiong Prefecture in Yunnan, joined with Dowen Kuanglu and the various barbarians of Puding Route in banditry; right vice director Wang Weineng advanced to punish them; the bandits retreated and held Yue Prefecture; when persuaded they did not submit; pingzhang Yesudai'er was dispatched leading ten thousand troops to capture them.
s0555.idiomatic: On renxu day Abang Longshao, garrison commander of Luoxiong Prefecture in Yunnan, joined with Dowen Kuanglu and the various barbarians of Puding Route in banditry; right vice director Wang Weineng advanced to punish them; the bandits retreated and held Yue Prefecture; when persuaded they did not submit; pingzhang Yesudai'er was dispatched leading 10,000 troops to capture them.

s0556.literal: When the army reached Qujing it joined Wang Weineng; advancing with princes Xibaochi and Yijilidai and others to press the bandit territory, Abang Longshao was captured and beheaded; the rest all dispersed.
s0556.idiomatic: When the army reached Qujing it joined Wang Weineng; advancing with princes Xibaochi and Yijilidai and others to press the bandit territory, Abang Longshao was captured and beheaded; the rest all dispersed.

s0557.literal: Yesudai'er was ordered to leave two thousand troops to garrison the area; those who followed the army with merit were all additionally rewarded.
s0557.idiomatic: Yesudai'er was ordered to leave 2,000 troops to garrison the area; those who followed the army with merit were all additionally rewarded.

s0558.literal: On guihai day the Kunshan, Jiading, and other places Naval Myriarchy Office was established.
s0558.idiomatic: On guihai day the Kunshan, Jiading, and other places Naval Myriarchy Office was established.

s0559.literal: On jiazi day Japanese merchants Youqing and others arrived at Qingyuan to trade, presenting gold armor as tribute; Jiangsu-Zhejiang branch secretariat pingzhang Alaowading and others were ordered to prepare it.
s0559.idiomatic: On jiazi day Japanese merchants Youqing and others arrived at Qingyuan to trade, presenting gold armor as tribute; Jiangsu-Zhejiang branch secretariat pingzhang Alaowading and others were ordered to prepare it.

s0560.literal: Prince of Liang Songshan was granted one thousand ingots of notes.
s0560.idiomatic: Prince of Liang Songshan was granted 1,000 ingots of notes.

s0561.literal: That month, because people in various prefectures of Guangdong, Jizhou, Longxing, Daozhou, Liuzhou, Hanyang, and Huai'an were starving, and Gan County suffered heavy rain and flooding, grain relief was granted in varying amounts.
s0561.idiomatic: That month, because people in various prefectures of Guangdong, Jizhou, Longxing, Daozhou, Liuzhou, Hanyang, and Huai'an were starving, and Gan County suffered heavy rain and flooding, grain relief was granted in varying amounts.

s0562.literal: Zhengzhou suffered violent wind, rain, and hail as large as chicken eggs; wheat, mulberry, and jujube were all damaged; this year's field rent was remitted.
s0562.idiomatic: Zhengzhou suffered violent wind, rain, and hail as large as chicken eggs; wheat, mulberry, and jujube were all damaged; this year's field rent was remitted.

s0563.literal: Locusts afflicted Zhending, Hejian, Baoding, and Henan.
s0563.idiomatic: Locusts afflicted Zhending, Hejian, Baoding, and Henan.

s0564.literal: Fifth month, on xinwei day Dadu suffered drought; envoys were dispatched bearing incense to pray for rain.
s0564.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on xinwei day, Dadu suffered drought; envoys were dispatched bearing incense to pray for rain.

s0565.literal: On renwu day the annual salt production of the Hejian, Shandong, Liang-Zhe, Liang-Huai, Fujian, and Guang-Hai Salt Transport Offices was increased by more than two hundred fifty thousand certificates.
s0565.idiomatic: On renwu day the annual salt production of the Hejian, Shandong, Liang-Zhe, Liang-Huai, Fujian, and Guang-Hai Salt Transport Offices was increased by more than 250,000 certificates.

s0566.literal: On guiwei day an edict forbade Tibetan monks traveling to and from the capital to use courier posts; boats and carts were to be provided instead.
s0566.idiomatic: On guiwei day an edict forbade Tibetan monks traveling to and from the capital to use courier posts; boats and carts were to be provided instead.

s0567.literal: Officials of the censorate, pacification commissions, and surveillance commissions were forbidden to buy salt certificates.
s0567.idiomatic: Officials of the censorate, pacification commissions, and surveillance commissions were forbidden to buy salt certificates.

s0568.literal: On yiyou day associate privy council director Taluqutai and Talahai were both made privy council directors.
s0568.idiomatic: On yiyou day associate privy council director Taluqutai and Talahai were both made privy council directors.

s0569.literal: King of Koryo Wang Ju was sent back to his country; a branch secretariat was still placed to pacify it; officials such as the state's Privy Council and Secretariat Directorate were all granted sealed edicts.
s0569.idiomatic: King of Koryo Wang Ju was sent back to his country; a branch secretariat was still placed to pacify it; officials such as the state's Privy Council and Secretariat Directorate were all granted sealed edicts.

s0570.literal: Imperial son-in-law Tuotemur was enfeoffed as Prince of Puyang and granted a gold seal; Princess Manggotai was made Grand Princess of Yun.
s0570.idiomatic: Imperial son-in-law Tuotemur was enfeoffed as Prince of Puyang and granted a gold seal; Princess Manggotai was made Grand Princess of Yun.

s0571.literal: On dinghai day an edict ordered right chancellor Harqasun Darqan, left chancellor Ahuqatai, and others to rectify all affairs; for appointment selection and revenue and grain matters, the central secretariat alone was to decide; the diligence or neglect of all offices was to be reported by name.
s0571.idiomatic: On dinghai day an edict ordered right chancellor Harqasun Darqan, left chancellor Ahuqatai, and others to rectify all affairs; for appointment selection and revenue and grain matters, the central secretariat alone was to decide; the diligence or neglect of all offices was to be reported by name.

s0572.literal: Prince Chubo, Martial and Majestic Prince of Xining, was granted thirty thousand ingots of notes.
s0572.idiomatic: Prince Chubo, Martial and Majestic Prince of Xining, was granted 30,000 ingots of notes.

s0573.literal: People in Liaoyang and Yidu were starving; relief loans were granted in varying amounts.
s0573.idiomatic: People in Liaoyang and Yidu were starving; relief loans were granted in varying amounts.

s0574.literal: Locusts afflicted Dadu, Zhending, and Hejian; water damaged crops in Pingjiang and Jiaxing and other prefectures.
s0574.idiomatic: Locusts afflicted Dadu, Zhending, and Hejian; water damaged crops in Pingjiang and Jiaxing and other prefectures.

s0575.literal: Sixth month, on guimao day censorate officials said: "Jiangnan branch censorate surveillance censor Jiaohua impeached envoy Li Yuan of the Jiangsu-Zhejiang branch secretariat for misconduct; the branch secretariat also sent persons to gather accusations; Jiaohua would not allow them to inspect the case files.
s0575.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on guimao day, censorate officials said, "Jiangnan branch censorate surveillance censor Jiaohua impeached envoy Li Yuan of the Jiangsu-Zhejiang branch secretariat for misconduct; the branch secretariat also sent persons to gather accusations; Jiaohua would not allow them to inspect the case files.

s0576.literal: Central secretariat officials again said Jiaohua and others did not follow the law, on their own authority dispatching soldiers to guard their gates, beating Li Yuan, and falsely accusing branch secretariat officials — in reality to warm provincial affairs.
s0576.idiomatic: Central secretariat officials again said Jiaohua and others did not follow the law, on their own authority dispatching soldiers to guard their gates, beating Li Yuan, and falsely accusing branch secretariat officials — in reality to warm provincial affairs.

s0577.literal: " An edict ordered the secretariat, censorate, and yeke jarquchi to try the case jointly.
s0577.idiomatic: An edict ordered the secretariat, censorate, and yeke jarquchi to try the case jointly.

s0578.literal: On guichou day the moon transgressed the upper star of Luo Rampart.
s0578.idiomatic: On guichou day the moon transgressed the upper star of Luo Rampart.

s0579.literal: On jiwei day Jupiter transgressed Kang.
s0579.idiomatic: On jiwei day Jupiter transgressed Kang.

s0580.literal: On renxu day Zongguan Cen Xiong of Laian Route rebelled; Huguang branch secretariat dispatched pacification vice commissioner Hudul Temur to summon and persuade him; Xiong had his son Shijian come to surrender; clothing was granted and he was dismissed.
s0580.idiomatic: On renxu day Zongguan Cen Xiong of Laian Route rebelled; Huguang branch secretariat dispatched pacification vice commissioner Hudul Temur to summon and persuade him; Xiong had his son Shijian come to surrender; clothing was granted and he was dismissed.

s0581.literal: The Huai-xi Circuit Surveillance Commission was restored.
s0581.idiomatic: The Huai-xi Circuit Surveillance Commission was restored.

s0582.literal: Daming and Yidu suffered great flooding; Jing Prefecture suffered continuous rain; locusts afflicted Longxing, Nankang, and other prefectures.
s0582.idiomatic: Daming and Yidu suffered great flooding; Jing Prefecture suffered continuous rain; locusts afflicted Longxing, Nankang, and other prefectures.

s0583.literal: Seventh month of autumn, on gengchen day the moon transgressed Ox.
s0583.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on gengchen day, the moon transgressed Ox.

s0584.literal: On xinsi day prisoners on all routes were released; those not covered by the regular amnesty were excluded.
s0584.idiomatic: On xinsi day prisoners on all routes were released; those not covered by the regular amnesty were excluded.

s0585.literal: Xunde and other places suffered hail damage to crops; frost in Hunyuan, Datong, killed grain; Pingjiang suffered great wind and the sea overflowed and washed away commoners' houses.
s0585.idiomatic: Xunde and other places suffered hail damage to crops; frost in Hunyuan, Datong, killed grain; Pingjiang suffered great wind and the sea overflowed and washed away commoners' houses.

s0586.literal: Daozhou, Wuchang, Yongzhou, Xingguo, Huangzhou, and Yuanzhou suffered famine; seventy-seven thousand eight hundred shi of grain were sold at reduced prices for relief.
s0586.idiomatic: Daozhou, Wuchang, Yongzhou, Xingguo, Huangzhou, and Yuanzhou suffered famine; 77,800 shi of grain were sold at reduced prices for relief.

s0587.literal: Eighth month, on renyin day Jupiter transgressed Root, and Mars transgressed the Supreme General of Supreme Palace Enclosure.
s0587.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on renyin day, Jupiter transgressed Root, and Mars transgressed the Supreme General of Supreme Palace Enclosure.

s0588.literal: Kaicheng Route suffered an earthquake; the princely palace and official and commoners' houses were all destroyed; more than five thousand persons including the former Prince of Qin's consort Yeliwang were crushed to death; more than thirteen thousand six hundred ingots of notes and more than forty-four thousand one hundred shi of grain were granted for relief.
s0588.idiomatic: Kaicheng Route suffered an earthquake; the princely palace and official and commoners' houses were all destroyed; more than 5,000 persons including the former Prince of Qin's consort Yeliwang were crushed to death; more than 13,600 ingots of notes and more than 44,100 shi of grain were granted for relief.

s0589.literal: On xinhai day Wang Ju's nephew Amuge was granted three thousand ingots of notes.
s0589.idiomatic: On xinhai day Wang Ju's nephew Amuge was granted 3,000 ingots of notes.

s0590.literal: On dingsi day the Temple of the Duke of Culture and Propagation in the capital was completed; the libation ceremony was performed; the supreme victim was used, the Ascending Song for music, and three sets of ceremonial robes were prescribed.
s0590.idiomatic: On dingsi day the Temple of the Duke of Culture and Propagation in the capital was completed; the libation ceremony was performed; the supreme victim was used, the Ascending Song for music, and three sets of ceremonial robes were prescribed.

s0591.literal: The Hanlin Academy was ordered to fix the music names and chapters.
s0591.idiomatic: The Hanlin Academy was ordered to fix the music names and chapters.

s0592.literal: Chengdu and other counties suffered famine; more than seven thousand shi of grain were sold at reduced prices for relief.
s0592.idiomatic: Chengdu and other counties suffered famine; more than 7,000 shi of grain were sold at reduced prices for relief.

s0593.literal: Ninth month, on jisi day Mars transgressed the Right Enforcer of Supreme Palace Enclosure.
s0593.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on jisi day, Mars transgressed the Right Enforcer of Supreme Palace Enclosure.

s0594.literal: On renshen day, because of the Birthday Festival, Duowa dispatched Kuanche and others to come offering congratulations.
s0594.idiomatic: On renshen day, because of the Birthday Festival, Duowa dispatched Kuanche and others to come offering congratulations.

s0595.literal: On renwu day Mars transgressed the Left Enforcer of Supreme Palace Enclosure.
s0595.idiomatic: On renwu day Mars transgressed the Left Enforcer of Supreme Palace Enclosure.

s0596.literal: Tenth month of winter, on jiachen day Venus transgressed Dipper.
s0596.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on jiachen day, Venus transgressed Dipper.

s0597.literal: On dingwei day sacrifice was performed at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
s0597.idiomatic: On dingwei day sacrifice was performed at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

s0598.literal: On xinhai day the moon transgressed Bi.
s0598.idiomatic: On xinhai day the moon transgressed Bi.

s0599.literal: On jiayin day the moon transgressed Well.
s0599.idiomatic: On jiayin day the moon transgressed Well.

s0600.literal: On dingmao day the kingdom of Annam dispatched Li Kangzong to present local products as tribute.
s0600.idiomatic: On dingmao day the kingdom of Annam dispatched Li Kangzong to present local products as tribute.
